import copy
import unittest
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, is_dataclass

from solution import Exhibit, ExhibitKind, ViewingMode, compile_exhibits


class CompileExhibitsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def item(self, code="x", **extra):
        value = {
            "code": code,
            "label": "Label " + code,
            "creator": "Creator",
            "fees": {"list": 12, "current": 7.5},
        }
        value.update(extra)
        return value

    def test_enums_and_frozen_dataclass(self):
        self.assertEqual({x.name for x in ExhibitKind}, {"PHYSICAL", "DIGITAL"})
        self.assertEqual({x.name for x in ViewingMode}, {"ONSITE", "REMOTE"})
        self.assertTrue(is_dataclass(Exhibit))
        result = compile_exhibits([[self.item()]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            result[0].label = "changed"

    def test_order_duplicates_fields_and_stop_at_empty_page(self):
        first = self.item("a", metadata={"tags": ["old"]})
        duplicate = self.item("a")
        ignored = self.item("later")
        pages = [[first, duplicate], [], [ignored]]
        original = copy.deepcopy(pages)
        result = compile_exhibits(pages, ExhibitKind.DIGITAL, ViewingMode.REMOTE)
        self.assertEqual([x.catalog_id for x in result], ["archive:a", "archive:a"])
        self.assertEqual(result[0].reference, "/exhibits/a")
        self.assertEqual(result[0].label, "Label a")
        self.assertEqual(result[0].creator, "Creator")
        self.assertEqual(result[0].list_fee, 12)
        self.assertEqual(result[0].current_fee, 7.5)
        self.assertIs(result[0].kind, ExhibitKind.DIGITAL)
        self.assertIs(result[0].viewing_mode, ViewingMode.REMOTE)
        self.assertEqual(pages, original)

    def test_raw_is_complete_deep_copy(self):
        source = self.item("a", metadata={"tags": ["one"]})
        result = compile_exhibits([[source]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        self.assertEqual(result[0].raw, source)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0].raw, source)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0].raw["metadata"], source["metadata"])
        source["metadata"]["tags"].append("input")
        self.assertEqual(result[0].raw["metadata"]["tags"], ["one"])
        result[0].raw["fees"]["list"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(source["fees"]["list"], 12)

    def test_empty_iterable_and_generator(self):
        self.assertEqual(compile_exhibits([], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.REMOTE), [])
        pages = (page for page in [[self.item("g")]])
        self.assertEqual(len(compile_exhibits(pages, ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.REMOTE)), 1)

    def test_invalid_types_and_missing_fields(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compile_exhibits(3, ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compile_exhibits([{}], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compile_exhibits([[[]]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compile_exhibits([], "PHYSICAL", ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            compile_exhibits([], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, "ONSITE")
        for field in ("code", "label", "creator", "fees"):
            value = self.item()
            del value[field]
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compile_exhibits([[value]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        for field, value in (("code", 1), ("label", None), ("creator", []), ("fees", [])):
            item = self.item()
            item[field] = value
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    compile_exhibits([[item]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        for fee, value in (("list", True), ("current", "7")):
            item = self.item()
            item["fees"][fee] = value
            with self.subTest(fee=fee):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    compile_exhibits([[item]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)
        item = self.item()
        del item["fees"]["current"]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_exhibits([[item]], ExhibitKind.PHYSICAL, ViewingMode.ONSITE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
